description: The blast radius of a change, offline: from the changed files (default: everything that differs from git HEAD, new files included; or `files`) backwards through the project's file graph (ext_resource, preload, class_name, includes, and paths the code loads later) to every scene that loads them, nearest first with the chain in between and the main scene marked; whether the change is global (an autoload or something an autoload loads, project.godot, a class_name many scripts use); the test files and saved scenarios that cover it; deleted files something still names; then the numbered checks to run for exactly this change (godot_review with the files, godot_check, the scenarios, the tests, the scene to play). Call it when you finished a set of edits, before you say the work is done: checking only the file you edited misses the scenes that instance it. Read-only.

detail.description: brief (capped lists) or full (everything); default brief

files.description: the changed res:// files (default: what differs from ref in git)

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

ref.description: the commit to compare with when files is not given (default HEAD)

name: godot_impact
title: What a change reaches, and what to run
